messages:
sara: FYI—we've got a customer escalation: per-model throughput panels are flatlined for a bunch of projects since ~0900 UTC. They say traffic continues but console shows no per-model lines.

matt: Can you paste the dashboard URL + a screenshot? Also which org / examples?

sara: Org: acme-ads. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/d/throughput/per-model. Screenshot attached (customer sent). Panels show a single grey line at 0 for all models. No spikes.

julie: Customer also reporting invoices lower than expected because token counters from UI are showing 0 for some models. Billing pipeline unaffected but UI looks broken.

matt: Curious if metrics changed. @anita can you check exporter -> prometheus -> grafana path? Quick check: curl the exporter on one node and grep for model label.

anita: I pulled metrics from one of the autoscaler exporters:
```
$ curl -s http://10.3.12.8:9100/metrics | egrep 'redwood_model_qps|redwood_model_requests_total' | head -n 5
redwood_model_requests_total{model_id="gpt-4-redwood",region="us-west2",instance="r1"} 12345
redwood_model_qps{model_id="gpt-4-redwood",region="us-west2"} 2.3
# HELP redwood_model_qps QPS per model
```
The exporter is emitting label `model_id` instead of the older `model` label. Grafana queries were summing by (model) so they return nothing.

matt: Ahhh — that would do it. Any recent deploys that touched exporter label names?

alec: We merged a metric rename last night in runtime-exporter: we decided to make label names explicit (model_id) to avoid collisions. Looks like we forgot to keep a compatibility alias. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime-exporter/pull/492 (renamed label).

sara: Customer asks for ETA on fix. Can we either update dashboards or add back `model` label? Which is faster?

anita: Short-term: update grafana queries to use `model_id` or change group by labels to use `instance` or `region`. But that's scattered across many dashboards and saved panels — error-prone.

alec: Long-term we should keep exporter backward-compatible. I'll push a small shim in exporter that emits both labels (model and model_id) until we do a planned metric migration. Deploy should be quick.

matt: Steps: 1) quick revert/shim in exporter + deploy to staging 2) smoke test metrics + dashboards 3) deploy to prod 4) follow-up to update docs and open migration notes.

alec: Working on a patch now — adding `model` label as alias to `model_id` in the metrics generation. Patch:```diff
- labels["model_id"] = modelID
+ labels["model_id"] = modelID
+ labels["model"] = modelID  // compatibility alias
```

I'll open PR in a minute.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for runtime-exporter PR #496 by alec to staging (sha: ab12c2f).

anita: Staging metrics now show both labels:
```
redwood_model_qps{model_id="gpt-4-redwood",model="gpt-4-redwood",region="us-west2"} 2.3
```
Grafana dashboard in staging shows per-model lines again.

deploy-bot: Deployment succeeded to production (runtime-exporter@ab12c2f) — canary started then rolled.

sara: Customer rechecked console and confirms graphs are back for their org. They thanked support. :tada:

julie: Logged the incident and customer note, offered a 10% credit for the confusion.

matt: Follow-ups: 1) Add a metric compatibility policy to the runbook 2) Add a CI test that checks dashboard queries against metric names/labels 3) Communicate the migration window when we change metrics.

anita: I'll add the runbook entry and the Prometheus relabel compatibility checklist.

alec: Filed PR to add compatibility shim (merged) and created an internal RFC for metric naming conventions.

sara: Closing the escalation — marking resolved.

julie: Nice triage — quick deploy saved the customer experience. :thumbsup:
